title: The Leaning Tower Started Leaning Before It Was Finished 🗼
caption:
The Leaning Tower was leaning before it was even finished 🗼
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. Construction of the Tower of Pisa began in 1173. By 1178, at the second floor, it was already sinking into soft ground. Work stopped for decades, and builders later made the upper floors taller on one side to correct the tilt. It took about two centuries to finish.
Would you have kept building? 👇
first_comment: Plan A: build a tower. Plan B: make the lean famous. Honestly iconic. 🗼👇
